statusDetail: Coverage-complete report-only audit across five representative paths.

page.notes: Public Arabic adult-video catalogue. Covered homepage, listing, video detail, search, and 404 recovery. Did not play media, create an account, or exercise payment because those were not needed to judge the selected public discovery journey.

paths.description: Homepage: entry, primary discovery surface, desktop/mobile and preference conditions.
Representative video detail and playback entry surface.
Search results with a query: representative findability flow.
Deliberate unknown URL: HTTP/network failure recovery template.

findings.summary: The site does not follow the user’s dark colour preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is byte-identical in appearance to the light desktop capture, and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, control, and accent colours.

findings.summary: Page-to-page changes are abrupt full navigations with no transition continuity.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition usage across the homepage, listing, and detail templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions for navigation, respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: The long listing does not provide scroll-state-aware navigation or progress feedback.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout measured 10,949px of content while the DOM/CSS probe found no scroll-state query or progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a small scroll-state-aware header or progress/back-to-top affordance on long listings.

findings.summary: Repeated video-card components depend only on viewport CSS, not their available container.
findings.evidence: The same cards appear in one and three-column contexts, while the CSS probe found no @container or container-type usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the reusable card grid container-aware so cards adapt wherever embedded.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated.
findings.evidence: The focus probe focused links, the search input, and menu button; every sampled control computed outline-style none and box-shadow none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator without suppressing native focus unless replaced.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Raw trace measured LCP 4,278ms; Lighthouse measured 5.3s and scored LCP 0.21.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP thumbnail/content, shorten dependency chains, and defer non-essential third-party scripts.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is delayed by parser resources and third-party scripts.
findings.evidence: HAR found parser-inserted styles/scripts and 248KB of third-party transfer; the trace measured LCP at 4.28s. DOM confirms the ad and main scripts are parser-inserted near the document end without defer/module.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep only critical CSS on the render path, defer first-party script, and load advertising/analytics after core content or consent.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 109KiB unused JavaScript and 13KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused bundles/rules and conditionally load page-specific and third-party code.

findings.summary: The document lacks a main landmark and visible keyboard focus.
findings.evidence: axe reported landmark-one-main and 12 regions outside landmarks; the focus probe found no visible outline on sampled controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main>, use semantic header/footer regions, and restore :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: The page logs browser errors during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console failed with two recorded console error entries.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the failing network/script calls and handle expected third-party failures without uncaught console errors.

findings.summary: Some thumbnails are rendered at insufficient resolution.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse image-size-responsive failed for three images, despite valid dimensions and aspect ratios.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve appropriately sized responsive image candidates with srcset/sizes.

findings.summary: The page triggers deprecated APIs, inspector issues, and BFCache blockers.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 16 deprecation warnings, an Inspector Issues failure, and three BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated APIs, resolve DevTools issues, and remove unload/cache-control patterns that prevent BFCache where possible.

findings.summary: Several links are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse crawlable-anchors failed and listed six non-crawlable anchors; the page otherwise has a viewport and robots access.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for every navigation target and buttons for non-navigation actions.

findings.summary: Cookie and content-injection defences are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers show no Content-Security-Policy. Cookie evidence found 7 cookies, all flagged insecure; PHPSESSID lacks Secure and HttpOnly, and kt_acctoken lacks HttpOnly and uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP and set session/account cookies Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: The page loads a broad advertising and tracking footprint before any visible consent choice.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 13 third-party origins, including Google Analytics and multiple ad domains. HAR measured 18 third-party requests and 247,986 bytes, about half the transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate non-essential analytics/ads behind an informed choice where required, and batch/defer remaining telemetry.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy is missing, no CSP frame-ancestors/Trusted Types policy exists, and cookies include SameSite=None values. HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, and Permissions-Policy are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive Referrer-Policy and CSP with frame-ancestors; evaluate Trusted Types for script sinks and tighten cross-site cookie use.

findings.summary: Arabic direction is implicit rather than declared and CSS is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The root declares lang="ar" but no dir attribute; the CSS probe found no logical inline/block properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir="rtl" on the root and migrate physical left/right spacing and positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Image delivery lacks responsive and modern formats.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 31/31 images without srcset, 7 legacy PNG/JPEG resources, and no modern-format image; Lighthouse also found low-resolution thumbnails.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP candidates, add srcset/sizes, and retain explicit dimensions.

findings.summary: Non-core advertising work runs during initial load.
findings.evidence: HAR shows several ad/analytics scripts on the initial path; trace records three long tasks and the slowest third-party requests take 1.2–2.1s.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer vendor work until after core content/interaction or consent, and pause non-visible/background processing.

findings.summary: Third-party code consumes a disproportionate share of the lightweight listing page.
findings.evidence: HAR measured 247,986 of 493,497 transferred bytes from third parties, with Google Tag Manager alone transferring 162,176 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget and replace or remove vendors that exceed their user value.
